items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Well, under my forein-law, you know. He taught me some. Well, Frank knew a few chords.

ctx.x: I'm sorry I didn't finish. Did you take a banjo later?

Well, under my forein-law, you know. He taught me some. Well, Frank knew a few chords. I didn't know a few chords. But the old man used to use the sword dog that much. Yeah, I got mad in the sword. He never would give me nothing. I bought it. I bought it. The fella had it in pawn and he sold me the ticket. I got it out for $34. It was $154. A big orduphonic banjo. It was beautiful.
Those Vegas are beautiful. Yeah, it was beautiful. It was beautiful. It was beautiful. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Did you play any other instruments?
